# Parks

> Comparison of official public parks and green spaces in Berlin and Vienna.
> Static, source-backed, and free of paid map APIs.

Canonical URL: https://parks.soli.blue/
Language: German
Geographic scope: Berlin, Germany and Vienna, Austria

## What the site provides

- A city comparison plus maps and searchable lists for Berlin and Vienna
- A population-weighted estimate of access within a 10-minute walk
- District and positively matched amenity filters
- Optional browser geolocation or a map-selected origin
- Local straight-line distance and 5/10/15-minute estimates
- Visible data source, map attribution, methodology, and freshness

The rings drawn from a selected map point are straight-line estimates. The
city-level access comparison is a separately computed pedestrian-network
estimate. Missing amenity coverage is not evidence that an amenity is absent.

## Public static data

- https://parks.soli.blue/data/cities.json — city catalog and comparison totals
- https://parks.soli.blue/data/access.json — access estimate and methodology
- https://parks.soli.blue/data/berlin/ — Berlin geometry, index, summary, sources
- https://parks.soli.blue/data/vienna/ — Vienna geometry, index, summary, sources

These files are build artifacts, not a stability-guaranteed public API. The
Berlin uses the official PITID; Vienna uses the official OBJECTID with a city
prefix.

## Sources and terms

Park and amenity data: Land Berlin WFS services (dl-de-zero-2.0) and Stadt Wien
WFS services (CC BY 4.0).
Population: EC JRC 2021 100 m census grid. Walking network: OpenStreetMap.
Background maps: basemap.de and basemap.at.
Project code: MIT.
